data.long_meaning: Harvansh is a Sanskrit name, derived from the words 'Hari' meaning God and 'Vansh' meaning treasure or lineage. It is believed that a child named Harvansh is a divine gift and a treasure to his family. According to Hindu mythology, Lord Vishnu is often referred to as Hari, and this name signifies the blessings of the deity.
